name: Firetail Resources Limited
summary: Firetail Resources Limited, an Australian company created in 2021 and located in Subiaco, acquires and develops mineral resource properties, prospecting for copper, gold, lithium, rubidium, nickel, cobalt and manganese. It fully owns the Paterson copper-gold project of about 1,000 square kilometers in the Paterson Province, and a roughly 1,850 square kilometer lithium project at Yalgoo and Dalgaranga.
